title: The speaker will examine the questions of WHY we must have digital transformation on our radar, how to pin it down and what disruption means in this context.
main_content:
The speaker will examine the questions of WHY we must have digital transformation on our radar, how to pin it down and what disruption means in this context.

Registration via e-mail at

Venue: ETH Zurich, LEE E 101, Leonhardstrasse 21, 8092 Zurich

The 17:15 Colloquium offers a platform for further education and discussion. The formula is a 30-minute presentation + a 30-minute discussion + a subsequent drinks reception = inspiration for our daily working lives. Dates for the spring semester 2019

Save the dates in the spring semester 2019 now already! On the following Thursdays, at 17.15: • 28.03.2019 • 25.04.2019 • 23.05.2019
